description: Asics Gel-Kayano series has long been a dependable running option for many. The brand, however, gave the series a philosophical shift away from rigid, intrusive plastic medial posts toward an integrated, holistic approach to support. With the all-new Gel-Kayano 33, Asics is attempting to strike a difficult balance, injecting a softer, max-cushion feel without compromising the predictable, rock-solid security that its core runners' community demands. Here's our review.
title: Asics Gel-Kayano 33 Review: Pure Comfort for Runners

description: IP ratings indicate how well a device is protected against dust and water under the IEC 60529 standard. This guide explains what the two digits in an IP rating represent and how popular ratings such as IP44, IP54, IP64, IP65, IP67, IP68, IP69 and IP69K differ. It also covers what these ratings mean in everyday use, their limitations, and why an IP-rated smartphone should not be considered completely waterproof.
title: IP Rating Explained: Everything You Need to Know Before Buying a Phone

description: The Redmi Turbo 5 may have been marketed as a gamer-oriented smartphone, but it also does well in the camera and battery department. It may not be the all-rounder you are looking for under Rs. 40,000 today, but it sure comes pretty close as it will check most boxes off your list.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 Review: A Gaming-Grade Smartphone That Will Appeal to Many

description: Switching to a new smartphone was usually considered a hassle, with the primary concern being leaving years of WhatsApp conversations behind. However, that is no longer the case. Earlier this year, the Meta-owned messaging app introduced a built-in cross-platform chat transfer feature. It allows users to securely move their chat history, including messages and media, between Android and iPhone and vice versa, without relying on third-party tools. In this guide, we will explain how you can transfer your WhatsApp chats from an Android phone to an iPhone in just a few simple steps.
title: How to Transfer WhatsApp Chats From Android to iPhone in India

title: Top Projectors Under Rs. 20,000 for Home Theatre in India: Lumio Arc 5, Crossbeats Lumex Flix and More
